articles.title: SP, Congress gave Bundelkhand dacoits; BJP brought jobs and defence corridor: Yogi Adityanath
articles.summary: Uttar Pradesh CM Yogi Adityanath alleged that previous SP and Congress governments provided "dacoits and country-made pistols" to Bundelkhand's youth, contrasting this with the BJP's efforts. He claimed the BJP government has uplifted the region by integrating youth into the mainstream and promoting development. This political statement highlights differing approaches to youth empowerment and regional progress in UP.

articles.title: HBO Max Returns to San Diego with Fan Experiences for "Lanterns" and "Stuart Fails to Save the Universe"
articles.summary: HBO Max will return to San Diego, offering fan experiences and hosting cast and creator panels for its upcoming series, 'LANTERNS' and 'STUART FAILS TO SAVE THE UNIVERSE'. These events, including a panel scheduled for July 23rd, highlight new content from the streaming platform, reflecting ongoing developments in digital entertainment and media.

articles.title: Sharp China: A Missile Test and New PLA Generals; The CITIC Plane Crash; America's Taiwan Interests; Guo Wengui Jailed and Ezra Jin Released
articles.summary: An episode of 'Sharp China' discusses the PLA Navy's recent Submarine-Launched Ballistic Missile (SLBM) test. Analysts Andrew and Bill delve into the details surrounding the test, specifically examining its timing and location. This event highlights ongoing developments within China's military capabilities, particularly its naval strategic forces, prompting analysis of its implications for regional security.

articles.title: Mint Explainer | Why does high-power Wi-Fi in India need a debate?
articles.summary: Telecom operators propose a strategy for faster home broadband access for millions, particularly in difficult areas, by avoiding extensive fibre cable laying. This aims to boost digital inclusion and bridge the connectivity gap. It represents a significant step towards strengthening national digital infrastructure, ensuring equitable high-speed internet access crucial for socio-economic development.

articles.title: China, Taiwan brace for Typhoon Bavi, possibly the most powerful storm in years
articles.summary: Typhoon Bavi, potentially the most destructive tropical storm in years, is churning southeast of Taiwan with winds nearing 200 kph. Both China and Taiwan are bracing for its significant impact, implementing extensive preparedness measures. This event underscores the critical importance of disaster management, national resilience, and potential regional cooperation in mitigating the effects of extreme weather events on population safety and infrastructure.

articles.title: Full-service flights from Riga, Latvia to Vietnam for €568
articles.summary: Air India and Air Baltic are collaborating to offer discounted full-service round-trip flights to Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, starting from 568. This presents an opportunity for travel, exploring Vietnam's renowned beaches like Da Nang and Phu Quoc, and experiencing its vibrant culture and street food. Such international connectivity initiatives highlight growing global travel accessibility.

articles.title: Shock in the Atlantic: 200,000 radioactive barrels have been lying on the seabed for 80 years
articles.summary: For over four decades, thousands of barrels containing radioactive waste were deliberately dumped onto the Atlantic Ocean seabed, a practice initiated nearly 80 years ago. This historical disposal raises significant long-term environmental concerns regarding marine ecosystems and potential future impacts, underscoring the critical importance of responsible hazardous waste management and its enduring global implications.

articles.title: Gold rate today (July 9, 2026): Check 24k, 22k, 20k and 18k gold jewellery prices from Joyalukkas, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Tanishq & IBJA in Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad, other cities
articles.summary: Gold prices across major Indian cities remained largely steady today, Thursday, July 9, 2026, at leading jewellery retailers. This stability offers potential buyers a predictable market.
